definitions.explanation: A small ornamental fish, typically orange or red, often kept as pets.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏祭|なつまつ}り→夏祭り：09871_natsumatsuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{金魚|きんぎょ}⟦すくい→すくい：09994_sukuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I scooped goldfish at the summer festival.
examples.notes: {金魚|きんぎょ}すくい = goldfish scooping (festival game)

examples.japanese: {金魚|きんぎょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{水槽|すいそう}→水槽：09956_suisou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飼|か}っている→飼う：08151_kau⟧。
examples.english: I keep goldfish in a tank.
Feeding the goldfish is the children's job.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧{金魚|きんぎょ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{白|しろ}い→白い：00587_shiroi⟧{金魚|きんぎょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。⟦うち→うち：01328_uchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{金魚|きんぎょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: There are red goldfish and white goldfish. Our red one is more lively.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→ころ：03091_koro⟧、⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{夏祭|なつまつ}り→夏祭り：09871_natsumatsuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{金魚|きんぎょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦すくった→すくう：09994_sukuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{死|し}んで→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧⟦しまって→しまう：03064_shimau⟧⟦{悲|かな}しかった→悲しい：00783_kanashii⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I scooped goldfish at the summer festival every year, but they always died quickly and I was sad.

notes:
{金魚|きんぎょ} (literally 'gold fish') are popular pets in Japan.

Cultural associations:
- {金魚|きんぎょ}すくい (goldfish scooping) - popular summer festival game
- Symbol of summer in Japan
- Often depicted in art and {浮世絵|うきよえ} (woodblock prints)

Common expressions:
- {金魚|きんぎょ}を{飼|か}う (to keep goldfish)
- {金魚|きんぎょ}{鉢|ばち} (goldfish bowl)
- {金魚|きんぎょ}のフン (literally 'goldfish droppings' - slang for someone who always follows another person around)

Counter: {匹|ひき} (for small animals)
